name: Daylight Assault
description: Collect 12 Treasure Cards and escape from the dungeon with them.

objectives.description: Escape from the dungeon via the Start tile with a total of 12 Treasure cards.

specialRules.description: Whenever you explore a white arrow tile, advance the time track. When it reaches 6, the sun sets. After sunset, draw an Encounter card at the start of your Villain Phase.
A Hero ending their Hero Phase on the Start tile may escape.

introText: The Heroes enter during daylight to steal Strahd’s treasures before he awakens.
victoryText: You have escaped the dungeon with Strahd's treasures! The daylight fades, but you are already safe.
defeatText: You failed to escape with the required treasures before being overwhelmed by the shadows.
